thread.title: Morgan Stanley raises Apple to 14% upside on Services potential - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Brandy Betz
title: Morgan Stanley raises Apple to 14% upside on Services potential - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Morgan Stanley reiterates its Overweight rating for Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) and raises the price target from $200 to $214, a 14% upside to yesterday’s close.
Analyst Katy Huberty counters the bears “arguing that App Store growth is sustainable and take rates are defensible. As a result, we believe Services margins have room to expand, and the market is undervaluing the Services business.”
Huberty thinks the Services business will represent 67% of sales growth in the next five years with the App Store leading the way.
Apple shares are up 0.1% to $188.55.
